# Perplexity Connector for Muse

💳 Paid API required: this connector needs a paid third-party API — the listing is free, but usage is billed. See Prerequisites for costs.
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source build (MIT) by @bluman1, listed here with credit to its creator. A Muse agent skill that asks Perplexity AI questions with live web search and citations, lists the available Sonar models, and runs raw searches. Honest note: Perplexity API usage is credit-metered, so warn-worthy on long runs. No secrets in the repo — API key stays in Muse's secure vault.
